surprises: NFRA_SCHWABBF-W3-S1: On the real dim_balance partition for 0840 on 2026-10-16 all 39 columns are non-numeric, so numeric_sums is empty and content_sha256 is the only check on figure values for this table. Issuer ruling: accepted as is.

NFRA_SCHWABBF-W3-S2: content_sha256 covered the provenance columns, so a moved _source_file key would read as DIFF. Issuer ruling: _source_file alone is excluded from content_sha256; _source_as_of, _master_observed, _section and _schema_version stay in the hash, and the instrument implements this with its own test arms.
